prompt: SVG2 CORS state style property presentation attribute URL fetch
answer: For URLs referenced by an SVG style property or presentation attribute, SVG 2 requires a potentially CORS-enabled request with the `corsAttributeState` set to **`"anonymous"`**. The URL is processed when the property is required to render the element. [[SVG 2 Linking](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CR-SVG2-20261006/linking.html)]
